modules.name: Looper
modules.description: Interval looper for NINJAM jams: an 8x8 Ableton-Session-style grid of one-interval loops, boundary-quantized from the Ninjam module's clock (expander). Scaffold: UX only, no audio yet.

modules.name: Ninjam
modules.description: NINJAM jam client: listen to a room's public Icecast/HTTP stream, or join the protocol to decode the live multi-user mix and transmit your own audio.

modules.name: Radio
modules.description: Streaming internet radio source (Icecast/HTTP) feeding audio into a patch.
